note: audit: 3 PASS / 2 FAIL, 7 issues (2 high, 4 medium, 1 minor), 0 blockers; 6 fixed, 1 refused with reasoning. Full pipeline run serially, no stage skipped; every source fetched and read in full before writing, all 27 external links re-fetched at audit (all 200). Both Dalai Lama records DOWNGRADED from the harvest's 'verified' hint to 'attributed': Wikiquote sources both only to secondary anthologies (Schaef 2000, Pendleton 2003), QI never investigated either, no primary source located. Declined to assert the near-universal '1989 Nobel acceptance speech' citation on the 'necessities, not luxuries' record — Wikiquote reproduces BOTH 1989 Nobel addresses on the page it cites and the sentence is in neither, while filing it to the 2003 anthology; recorded as unconfirmed rather than refuted since Wikiquote excerpts and nobelprize.org is egress-blocked. Two high findings were the same defect on both Dalai Lama pages: the negative claim 'QI has not investigated this line' hyperlinked to QI's HOMEPAGE, which cannot support it (de-linked, stated as our own search result). One medium: Sophocles record's JSON-LD Quotation.text carried Cephalus's narration ('Peace, he replied') while creator was Sophocles, so the machine-readable payload had Sophocles saying 'he replied' about himself (elided). Two mediums: Venice trail pinned quoted cable wordings to lending-restricted archive.org catalogue records containing no text (re-anchored to QI, which transcribes both) — these were filed high and downgraded by the skeptic pass, since the sentences do label those links as catalogue records. Refused: creator.birthDate '-0497' for Sophocles is off by one under ISO 8601 astronomical numbering (497 BC = -0496), but it matches the corpus-wide convention across 1,762 records (Aesop -0620, Aristotle -0384) — a real fix is one central decision plus a backfill, not a per-record edit. Could not establish: QI contradicts ITSELF on record 1's earliest date (prose says 1941, its own citation says 8 March 1942) so the page reports both and asserts neither; no primary source for either Dalai Lama line, so no isPartOf work named; record 5's Nobel venue; the Niven film dialogue at first hand (QI's only citation is a YouTube upload, so the page presents it as QI's transcription, not verified film text). Left two source typos uncorrected rather than silently fixing them: QI spells the 1941 translator 'Cornfield' (Cornford) and its footnote title reads 'The $64,00 Answer'. Generator seam reported not fixed (workflows/ is a merge-gate scope escape): prep-wave.js:207 leadName splits on commas, so a fuller 'Tenzin Gyatso, 14th Dalai Lama' would have reduced to 'tenzin gyatso', differed from magnet 'Dalai Lama' and stamped a FALSE creditedTo on an attributed record whose author IS the Dalai Lama — the name-expansion trap in a new form; using exactly 'Dalai Lama' makes the guard withhold correctly. Egress-blocked this run: nobelprize.org, dalailama.com, ia-fts.archive.org, ia-pub-fts-api.archive.org, api.archivelab.org, google.com — per-host, NOT the general-egress STOP case (wikiquote, QI, gutenberg, archive.org all reachable). Preflight exception (b) again: container started detached on a feature branch with local main 27 commits stale.
